text: Our wholesale customers order by phone today, which ties up two people all morning. We want a portal where a shop owner logs in, sees their own negotiated price list, repeats last month's order in two clicks and downloads a GST invoice. Sales reps approve orders placed on credit. It has to stay in sync with our Tally accounting system.
notes: B2B ordering still belongs to the E-Commerce family. Tally is a named integration (P-05 PRESENT); whether it also counts as a technical constraint is the judgement call on P-04, labelled PARTIAL_DEEP for the portal-only hint.
